instrument: Original public example Bitcoin all-time INDEX1D is replaced by explicitly chosen BinanceBTCUSDT spot native UTC1d; this is not source feed or exchange equivalence.
evaluation: 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z through2025-01-01T00:00:00Z exclusive; full24calendar months including initial cash/readiness period. Prior exposed availability-selected window, NOT OOS.
monthly_reporting: Month return=end equity/previous month end equity-1; first denominator100000. Continuous account and indicators, no monthly resetting or selective omission of cash/zero-trade months.

capital.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
capital.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent
capital.independent_QA: Independent money/quantity fields compare exact Decimal numerical equality with no tolerance/quantization; nonnumeric identity/time/counter fields exact. Different trailing-zero representations from equivalent normal-domain oracle algebra are retained as QA evidence, not accepted if values differ. Same implementation recovery remains byte-exact. No blanket all-Decimal-domain equivalence claim.

execution.at_open: Execute earliest-due pending action if due_index<=currentindex and actual holdings permit. Stale is logged/discarded; no sameopen roundtrip or reentry. No out-of-window fill.
at_close_sequence: Update the current completed-close indicator. Compute raw entry/exit from the frozen event/state definition, independent of holdings.
Raw opposite event cancels pending opposite intent before position gating; if both events arise exit/cancel-buy has priority.
Schedule buy only if flat and raw entry; sell only if long and raw exit.
Same-direction repeat retains original earliest due; absent event does not cancel an existing intent.
All calendar labels refer to UTC bar-open date; signal close knowledge becomes actionable at following bar open or declared lag2.
No warmup intents; no shorting, discretionary stop, ROI target, extra filter or calendar exclusions.
execution.lag2: Raw opposite event at t+1 cancels pending intent due t+2. Absence of event retains original intent/due, no repeated deferral.

valuation: Endbar equity=cash+quantity*rawclose. No funding/interest, no dividend assumptions needed for spot BTC. No terminal liquidation or hypothetical exit fee; report residual inventory and pending action separately. No fill outside evaluation.

identity.precision: Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN from raw decimal text
identity.exit: none; no fictitious terminal fee or liquidation

benchmark.comparison: One existing base-cost control referenced for all four strategy cases; do not describe it as fee0/fee20 matched control. No new benchmark execution authorized.
benchmark.verification_limit: Frozen actual M1258control identity/source hashes reused, not newlyexecuted; compare basecost only, no fee0/20 or delay2 matchedcontrol claim.

statistics.base_series: 731 raw daily-close equity values including cash days, with initial100000 prepended only for returns/drawdown
statistics.sharpe_zero_cash: mean(r)/sample_std(r,ddof=1)*sqrt(365); null when standard deviation is0
statistics.monthly_return: month final equity/prior month final equity-1; firstdenominator100000; all24calendar months continuous, no reset
statistics.monthly_counts: fills by execution UTC month; days_long=endclose quantity>0; allzero activity months retained
statistics.roundtrip: a buy followed by a sell; netpnl=sale cash_after-entry cash_before; open trade excluded from win_rate
statistics.win_rate: strictly positive netpnl/closedroundtrips; zero included denominator; null if no closedtrade
statistics.exposure: endclose bars quantity>0 divided by731; no intrabar inference
statistics.fee_total: sum exact Decimal fees; represented decimaltext
statistics.floats: Decimal values converted to float64 for numpy metrics only; no float in indicators, order eligibility, allocation, valuation
statistics.serialization: CSV UTF8 csv.writer default CRLF; booleans0/1; missing empty; Decimal str no quantization; JSON indent2 UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False newline; no timestamps in deterministic results

stop_or_roi: No intrabar stop/ROI added when absent from catalog; gap risk borne by nextopen proxy.

indicator.recurrence: For t>50, avg=prev+(current-prev)/Decimal50, separatelygain/loss, Decimal50 HALF_EVEN. Fixedorderingis adaptation, not claimedPineequivalence.

entry: RSI[t]>SMA_RSI[t] and RSI[t-1]<=SMA_RSI[t-1], all4ready; currentequality no event.
exit: RSI[t]<SMA_RSI[t] and RSI[t-1]>=SMA_RSI[t-1], all4ready; currentequality no event.
